profile: Knight-Swift provides freight transportation services across North America, serving shippers with full truckload, less-than-truckload, logistics, and intermodal offerings. It transports or arranges transportation for general commodities using company equipment, independent contractors, and third-party carriers. Its nationwide network of business units and terminals serves customers in the United States and Mexico, with services delivered through its Truckload, LTL, Logistics, and Intermodal segments.
